question: Marvell-inspired network. The planner cannot tell whether the notice covers TW_air only (narrow) or every air lane (broad). Is it worth paying, in time or money, to confirm the scope before week 1, compared with assuming one reading or hedging?

varied.reason: Same lane and grid as benchmarks/scope_misread_v1/config.json, so the two studies can be read together.

reveal_note: Without confirmation the scope shows at the start of this week: 7 is when the window opens, the latest the two-stage model allows; 4 is three weeks of warning. Confirmation means knowing before week 1.

under_reading.note: The reverse of scope_misread_v1: the notice covers every air lane and the planner plans for TW_air only. Learning after the window (week 10) or never can leave dispatches that exceed the space that exists; such cases are kept with the violated constraint.

decided_before_running: Fixed after seeing scope_misread_v1 (over-reading only). No under-reading or hedging result had been computed. Zero-value and infeasible results are kept.
